title: forge.yaml
description: Configuration file for the forge script runner.

commands.description: Map of command names to their definitions.

command.description: A runnable forge command. Must have either 'script' (backed by a script file) or 'run' (composite command), but not both.

description.description: A short description of what this command does. Shown in 'forge --list'.

script.description: Path to the script file, relative to the manifest directory. Each script lives in its own subdirectory under .forge/scripts/.

run.description: Steps to execute for a composite command. Steps run sequentially. Each step is either a command name (string) or a parallel block.

runStep.description: A step in a composite command. Either a command name (with optional inline args), a parallel block, or an explicit command+args object.

oneOf.description: Name of a command to run, optionally followed by inline arguments (e.g. 'clean --dryrun').

parallel.description: Commands to run in parallel. Each entry is a command name, optionally followed by inline arguments.

oneOf.description: A command reference with explicit arguments.

command.description: Name of the command to run.

args.description: Arguments to pass to the command.
